content:
Following the discussion in Fix for fun_prop on PFun (context: Computability Theory), I have opened PR #38534 which refactors PFun from a type alias into a strict structure with a FunLike instance.

The Good:

  • PFun is now natively compatible with modern Mathlib infrastructure (like fun_prop).
  • We successfully removed the respectTransparency false hack from Category/PartialFun.lean! The structure makes typeclass resolution robust enough that this workaround is no longer needed.

The Not-So-Good:

  • The strict structure boundary breaks definitional equality. Tactics like simp and grind can no longer automatically "see through" the function, meaning several proofs in Computability Theory grew in size (requiring explicit ext + simp breakdowns).

Feedback and reviews are very welcome!

I just published https://github.com/AlexeyMilovanov/ComputabilityTheory.

It ports and extends material from https://github.com/tannerduve/computability to modern Mathlib, adapts selected results from https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/28151, and develops fun_prop support using the bundled PFun/FunLike refactor proposed in https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/38534.

The repository also includes a formalization of the Friedberg–Muchnik theorem: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Friedberg%E2%80%93Muchnik_theorem.
